name: fridge
phrases: Your fridge does not make **cold**.
Your fridge does not make cold.
It moves **heat**. Out of the box, into your kitchen.
It moves heat. Out of the box, and into your kitchen.
Cold is just **less heat**.

But heat only flows from **hot to cold** by itself.
But heat only flows from hot to cold by itself.
Pushing it the other way takes **work**.
Pushing it the other way takes work.
A liquid called **refrigerant** loops through sealed pipes.

The **compressor** squeezes the gas, so it gets hot and high pressure.

The hot gas flows through coils called the **condenser**.
The hot gas flows through coils called the condenser, on the back or underneath.
Room air is cooler, so heat flows **out**, and the gas becomes liquid.

Next, the liquid squeezes through the **expansion valve**.

Pressure drops. Some of it flashes to vapor, and it turns **colder than your food**.

So an open door **warms** your room.

A **thermostat** switches the compressor on and off.

Food safety: fridge **40°F or below**, freezer **0°F**.
